reason: Reads one page live from Notion, as drive-cli's documents get reads one live from Google; documents show is kept for the local copy that step 2 adds (docs/dev/DESIGN.md, Commands). Review when the vocabulary names a live read beside show.

The link a child page gets before its text is read, in Notion's own form https://app.notion.com/p/{page-id} (src/sync/source.ts); a person opens it, notion never sends a request there, and hostFetch would refuse one.
Notion's list comments takes only a page or block and a cursor (https://developers.notion.com/reference/list-comments); there is nothing to filter by on Notion's side.

Each database has its own properties, so no fixed set of query fields can describe them; --filter takes Name<op>Value checked against the database's schema and sent as Notion's filter (https://developers.notion.com/reference/filter-data-source-entries; docs/dev/DESIGN.md, Rows). Review when cli-core's list query takes fields read at run time.
The profile's few saved folder pairs, read from one local file; nothing to filter by. cli-core mounts it (fileMirrorsCommand) with no query.
The events of one file of one mirror, already named by its arguments; nothing more to filter by.

The conflicts the last sync of each mirror left, read from its local state file: a handful per mirror, already narrowed by the optional mirror id. cli-core mounts it (fileConflictsCommand) with no query.
